evidence.text: File:老-seal.svg identifies the image as a modern vector depicting 老 in Shuowen seal-script style. It links the original SVG, gives the Hanziyuan image reference s06111, and states that the vector representation is public domain, with attribution appreciated but not required. The modern vector is not an ancient artifact image.
evidence.title: File:老-seal.svg

evidence.field: oraclePiece.php, character analysis and usage examples
evidence.text: The entry interprets 老’s oracle form as 人, 毛 and 丨 (staff), depicting a bent, long-haired person holding a staff. It reports the staff written 匕 in bronze forms and sometimes miswritten 止, with later upper-part variation and a tentative phonetic role for 由 in one form. It reports oracle use as a place name and bronze uses for an elder, ‘old’, senior ministers and 老 written for 考 ‘father’; the listed Warring States examples include 舜乃老. These are source-reported examples, not a complete semantic chronology.
evidence.title: 漢語甲骨部件分析: 老

evidence.source: 說文解字 and Duan Yucai commentary, ShuoWen.org
evidence.text: The received Shuowen text glosses 老 as 考, says a person aged seventy is called 老, and analyzes the form as 人、毛、匕, explaining it through whitening hair. Duan Yucai discusses reciprocal glossing and suggests that the seal form could derive from 毛匕, without 人 as a separate element. These are later lexicographic accounts and do not establish the oracle graph’s origin.
evidence.title: 說文解字「老」

search_audit.outcome: Inspected the 老 Commons description page, ShuoWen entry/commentary, CUHK analysis and Academia Sinica rights notice. The original SVG, Commons API, other exact seal-file pages and three Unihan pages failed to open.

gaps: The direct SVG URL is verified from its Commons page, but the image fetch returned a cache miss. No pixel-level inspection was performed.
The Commons seal image is a modern vector reconstruction in Shuowen seal style, not a photograph or scan of an ancient artifact.

The oracle place-name use reported by CUHK is not linked there to the lexical ‘old’ sense and has no absolute date supplied. Reported bronze and Warring States usages do not establish a complete semantic chronology.
CUHK describes staff-shape variation and later upper-part variation; the full graphic sequence and reasons for each change are not established by the inspected evidence.
The official Unihan pages for 老, 考 and 孝 could not be inspected. Their local readings remain local evidence only; no ancient phonetic relationship is inferred from modern readings.
No local source extract is recommended: no bulk reuse terms were verified for the repeated text sources, and the accessible image license applies to this single Commons vector.

items.period: Shuowen seal-script style; modern vector file uploaded 2009, updated 2021
items.caption: Modern vector depiction of 老 in Shuowen seal-script style. It offers a later form for comparison with the oracle and bronze descriptions; it is not an ancient artifact image.
items.alt: Modern vector drawing of 老 in a seal-script form.
items.selection_reason: The exact Commons description page identifies the character and script style, links the original SVG, and explicitly states public-domain release for the vector. The seal form complements the CUHK account of earlier oracle and bronze forms and the later Shuowen analysis.
items.rights: Public domain release stated on the Commons description page; attribution not required but appreciated.

limitations.text: Original SVG open returned a cache miss; the URL and file identity come from the inspected Commons page, but the pixels were not visually inspected in this research pass. The image is a modern vector, not an ancient object photograph.
